panel.name: preview_panel
panel.tool_tip: Your train as it will look: its engine and what follows. Drag to turn it.

floater.text: It arrives in your inventory in a train box. Rez the box beside your own track (laid with the track tool), touch it and choose Put on track. Then click the engine's cab to drive. The colours, name, number, company lettering and logo are yours: the train carries no other railway's name or emblem.

combo_box.name: train_type
combo_box.tool_tip: Steam, diesel, high-speed, bullet train or shunter

slider.name: carriages
slider.tool_tip: How many coaches or wagons it pulls

combo_box.name: carriage_style
combo_box.tool_tip: How the coaches or wagons look

color_swatch.label: Lower
color_swatch.name: coach_lower
color_swatch.tool_tip: The coaches' lower panels. Click to choose a colour.

color_swatch.label: Upper
color_swatch.name: coach_upper
color_swatch.tool_tip: The coaches' upper panels. Click to choose a colour.

combo_box.name: livery
combo_box.tool_tip: A colour scheme of ours, or your own colours

color_swatch.label: Body
color_swatch.name: main_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: Its main colour. Click to choose a colour.

color_swatch.label: Band
color_swatch.name: second_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: Its second colour (a band or lower body), when it has one. Click to choose a colour.

line_editor.name: train_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Its name: on the nameplates, and the name you drive it by (up to 24 letters)

line_editor.name: train_number
line_editor.tool_tip: Painted on the cab side (up to 8: A to Z, 0 to 9, spaces and -). Leave it empty for the one shown.

line_editor.name: company
line_editor.tool_tip: Your railway's name, lettered on the tender or the engine's sides (up to 32 letters). Leave it empty for none.

button.name: logo_btn
button.label: Choose picture...
button.tool_tip: Your own emblem (PNG or JPEG, under 1 MB), put on the sides of the engine, tender and coaches

check_box.name: logo_ok
check_box.label: This logo is mine to use and follows the grid's rules
check_box.tool_tip: No one else's company logo or trade mark, and nothing sexual or offensive

check_box.name: public_check
check_box.label: Let other people drive it
check_box.tool_tip: Anyone who sits in its cab may drive it. Otherwise only you drive; anyone may still ride.

slider.label: Top speed (m/s)
slider.name: speed
slider.tool_tip: The fastest it may go, in metres a second

button.name: cancel_btn
button.label: Cancel the order
button.tool_tip: Take your order back while it is still waiting for the yard (nothing has been charged)

button.name: buy_btn
button.label: Buy credits...
button.tool_tip: Open the AI credits shop in your browser

button.name: build_btn
button.label: Build it
button.tool_tip: Send your design to the yard. It is built and put in your inventory; you pay only once it is there.
